runtime_scope: pre-release pilot before the final source-path routing and ordinary-code Stop fixes; not an effect test of those fixes

arms.lean: 0.6.0 fast launcher and compact normative reading, evidence compiler off
arms.new: 0.6.0 including opt-in evidence compiler and product hints

protocol.design: two task genres x two reversed-order repeats x four arms = 16 valid outputs; serial fresh readonly projects
protocol.source_scope: real previously published plugin measurements, not invented company observations; ASCII source packets identical in all arms
protocol.primary: source/number fidelity, argument, concrete decision/reader exercise usability; no overall quality score
protocol.review: condition-label-masked development AI against frozen six criteria per task; not independent or real reader testing
protocol.secondary: full wall time incl synchronous hooks, hook/tool durations, input/cache, fulfillment and product budget

review.reviewer: development AI, not independent or real reader
review.masking: IDs randomized before review; source citation paths leaked several condition labels on initial read. Subsequent excerpts sanitized. Not a strict blind review. Mapping file not opened before freeze.

incidents: Initial off answer retained byte-for-byte; Windows provided-path accounting repaired without regenerating text.
One resume process failed before model initialization/output; subsequent normal resume completed the frozen schedule.
A normally reviewed hook setup CLI turn may have overlapped first off timing; report the timing sensitivity separately.

Before reading answers, generator found to impute unmeasured work-report long_dash_ranges as zero. Six report drafts repeat it. Do not credit these as observed formatting evidence. Time/input and compiler-declared metrics unaffected. Corrected future examples omit the column.
Citation paths leaked condition names during initial development review; not a strict blind or independent review.

Both task prompts contained a .kpdm source path and a complete-draft phrase; old broad route regex selected full reading. Normative context is the same across old/lean here. Fixed after pilot, without rewriting results.
